# Uniform and non-uniform motion

<!-- STEP id="uniform" -->
An object covers equal distances in equal intervals of time. This is **uniform motion** in a straight line: it moves at a constant speed.

<!-- STEP id="non-uniform" -->
If it covers unequal distances in equal intervals of time, the motion is **non-uniform**. Growing gaps mean the speed is increasing. Shrinking gaps mean the speed is decreasing.
